title: StormWall reports first DDoS attacks in Russia involving the Kairos botnet
date_note: CNews published StormWall's findings on 26 November; the attacks it describes ran from 1 to 23 November.
geo_basis: The attacks are described as in Russia; the page names no city, country centre used
summary: CNews reports that StormWall found the first DDoS attacks in Russia involving the Kairos botnet, which it says ran from 1 to 23 November 2026. StormWall says they most often targeted telecom companies, cloud providers, financial organizations and online retailers, and the largest exceeded 2.1 Tbit/s. It says Kairos infects Linux devices through an open Telnet service with an empty root password.
plain: Security firm StormWall says it saw the first DDoS attacks in Russia using the Kairos botnet, which it says spreads to Linux devices with open Telnet and an empty root password.
exec: StormWall says attacks with this botnet hit telecom, cloud, financial and retail firms in Russia, the largest above 2.1 Tbit/s.
action: StormWall advises disabling Telnet if unused, forbidding remote root login without a password, changing default credentials and restricting access to network equipment admin interfaces.

evidence.quote: которые произошли с 1 по 23 ноября 2026 г.

validation.note: CNews only, relaying the vendor StormWall's findings; StormWall's own page was not read and no second publisher found.

review.note: Compared 1-23 Nov window, 2.1 Tbit/s, Telnet, targets and advice against CNews
